summary: Implementation Design freezes the AI4X remote MCP boundary, canonical explicit pytest entrypoints, and critical architecture guards. The targeted validation slice now passes end-to-end in the warmed environment; the remaining operational signal is cold-start /session latency on a fresh OPENCODE container.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Initialize the registered remote MCP endpoint, list tools, then call ai4x_query with command=catalog.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The response exposes non-empty databases and total_databases equals the databases length.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Passed during the implementation-design targeted validation rerun after aligning the workspace MCP registration URL with the frozen contract.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Call remote ai4x_query with command=query and a selected sourceId through the registered MCP endpoint.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The response source_id matches the request and exposes valid items/count semantics.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Passed during the implementation-design targeted validation rerun after aligning the workspace MCP registration URL with the frozen contract.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Call remote ai4x_query with command=schema, then command=detail using one returned detail pointer.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The schema payload exposes detail pointers and the detail payload matches the requested kind/type.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Passed during the implementation-design targeted validation rerun after aligning the workspace MCP registration URL with the frozen contract.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Trigger the real OPENCODE flow against the registered MCP environment and collect session tool activity.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The session contains completed ai4x_query catalog/schema/query calls.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Passed during the implementation-design targeted validation rerun after aligning the workspace MCP registration URL with the frozen contract.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Read opencode.json and workspace.contract.json, then inspect isolated runtime support paths.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The canonical remote MCP declaration, fallback constraint, and required local runtime files are present.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Passed during the implementation-design targeted validation rerun after aligning the workspace MCP registration URL with the frozen contract.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: runtime architecture contract guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.kind: architecture boundary guard; dependency direction guard; explicit entrypoint correctness guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read workspace runtime contracts and canonical explicit AI4X acceptance source sections.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Remote MCP remains canonical and explicit AI4X acceptance tests do not execute local AI4X wrappers directly.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: architecture contract baseline guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.kind: explicit entrypoint correctness guard; key implementation traceability guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read canonical explicit entrypoint files and inspect their declared function names and architecture tags.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Canonical pytest node ids and traceability tags remain bound to the frozen explicit entry files.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: workspace compatibility surface tests
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Invoke workspace-local compatibility tools and inspect workspace-local agent contracts outside the single explicit dependency-baseline testcase.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Compatibility surfaces remain internally coherent without redefining the canonical AI4X remote MCP acceptance boundary.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: real opencode server availability guard
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Probe the real AI4X environment and then open a real OPENCODE session at http://127.0.0.1:8124.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: The real OPENCODE server accepts session creation and the real AI4X-backed flow completes without connection refusal.

supportingNonExplicitTests.name: agent scenario compatibility tests
supportingNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Read workspace-local agent/tool files, including ai4x_query_local.js compatibility behavior.
supportingNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Scenario-specific agent contracts remain consistent with the current compatibility surface until Coding/Repair intentionally refactors them.

codingTargets.failureSignal: On a fresh container start, the first successful POST /session on http://127.0.0.1:8124 took about 21 seconds before returning, so immediate readiness after docker-compose up is not deterministic.
codingTargets.nextAction: If Coding/Repair needs deterministic immediate readiness after docker-compose up, add startup warm-up or readiness gating in the container runtime without changing the frozen tests.

openGaps: A fresh OPENCODE container still shows cold-start /session latency before the first session becomes ready; the warmed environment passes the frozen targeted validation slice.
Workspace-local compatibility surfaces such as .opencode/tools/ai4x_query_local.js still exist and are treated as support/evolvable surfaces rather than frozen intent artifacts.

Implementation Design does not yet retire the broader ThreatIntelAnalyst compatibility surface; that follow-up remains outside the AI4X-only explicit acceptance baseline unless promoted by a future intent or implementation contract change.
